claims.text: Antonius, Embraced by the Ventrue Antediluvian centuries before, ruled as a warlord among the Gallic tribes and chose to join Rome when its legions arrived.
Antonius met Michael the Wanderer in the decades before Christ; the two became allies and lovers.
When Michael grew fascinated with Christianity, Antonius gave the counsel and support that made the Dream conceivable.
The Dracon is said to be the first childe of the Tzimisce Antediluvian, and Michael never learned the Dracon’s true origins.
Holding to the clan’s creed of change, the Dracon sought to transform the world itself, raising and toppling kingdoms and faiths.
On a visit to Cyprus some time after A.D. 100, Michael met the Dracon, and the two were soon enthralled with each other.

title: The Trinity and the family system

claims.text: Outside the Latin Quarter, every Cainite in the city belongs to a family by Embrace or adoption, and family status brings both rights and duties.
The Triumvirate set up the family system at the Second Council in A.D. 475 so the city would not decay as Rome had, giving each family a defined role.
Modelled on the Holy Trinity, the three founders cast themselves as Father, Son and Spirit, and their three broods together form the Trinity.
Lesser families called scions hold status under one member of the Trinity in return for serving the Dream, and the Status Background measures place in this system rather than under a prince.
The Michaelites are organised in artisan guilds, each with a muse, a Cainite of exemplary skill who sponsors promising talent.
Many of Michael’s followers shared a blood oath with their sire and slowly fell into the same delusion that Michael is the Archangel Michael.
The family is falling into chaos as Michael drifts in and out of torpor and Petronius struggles to hold its interests together.
Not since the Iconoclasm feud have the three great families been on such poor terms.

title: The Magnus Orthodox Lasombra
summary: A three-member Lasombra family close to Michael.

claims.text: Before Michael came, Lasombra ruled Byzantium behind a pagan cult of Aphrodite and called themselves the oldest clan in the city.
Michael insists the family count exactly three members, though Magnus sometimes sires hidden childer.
Magnus and the two known childer do not think Michael truly an angel but believe they can raise Michael to that state.
Around 1197 the city stands at the edge of ruin, threatening to drag the Dream down with it.
Recent arrivals include the Nosferatu Fra’ Raymond and brood from the Crusader States, hidden by the Malachite Nosferatu, and the Ventrue Basil of Thessalonika with the mad Caitiff prophet Stanislav.
In the crowded Latin Quarter, newly arrived Cainites set themselves up as saints and gods, trading drops of vitae to small cults for total obedience.

title: Khidre, the Green Man
summary: A figure of legend older than the city.

claims.text: Tales of Khidre, the Green Man, predate both Islam and Christianity, and Sufis honour Khidre as a saint who brings revelation.
Khidre is said to be some kind of fae who rides a grey horse through the forests of Anatolia, seen only for an instant.
